title: Prelaunch Impact Matrix & KPI Scenario Planner
content:
Purpose:
This is a working prelaunch impact matrix + KPI scenario planner for the Q4 product activation. Goal: give a concise decision surface for go/no-go and early rollback triggers, aligned to owners and monitoring hooks. This doc prioritizes operationalizable thresholds over long prose.

High-level summary (one-liner):
Map major launch risks to measurable KPIs, outline 3 escalation scenarios (green/amber/red), and attach concrete runbook steps and comms for each.

Context and scope:
- Feature: Dynamic ballot routing + model fallback for hosted API customers (v2).
- Release surface: Hosted API, Dedicated routing changes, Console rollout flags.
- Audience: Product Ops (owner), Eng (serving-runtime + infra), SRE, Solutions Eng, Support.
- Assumption: Baseline traffic from beta cohorts (50k DAU from 2 partners) will scale to 2M requests/day in 30 days if no throttles.

Owners and channels:
- Product Ops lead (primary owner): Maya Thompson (this doc).
- Eng SRE lead: Ethan Park.
- Serving runtime tech lead: Lina Alvarez.
- Solutions / CS escalation: Samir Gupta.
- Slack channels: #prodops-launch (primary), #sre-oncall, #serving-runtime.
- Pager: SRE oncall (Escalation path in CONFLUENCE-PLT-4521).

Key KPIs to track (metrics + measurement source):
1) 99p latency (ms) - per-model and per-region (console/dashboards: /dashboards/latency-99p)
2) Error rate (5xx / total) - global and per-route (console/dashboards: /dashboards/errors)
3) Token cost per 1k tokens (billing pipeline) - observable in billing-reports sheet
4) Successful response rate for function/tool-calls (for structured output flows)
5) Queue depth / pending requests (serving-runtime metrics)
6) Model quality regression signal: evaluation prompt set pass rate (evals job id in linked artifacts)
7) Customer-facing SLA violations (tickets flagged by support tag 'launch-sla')

Thresholds & decision rules (quick rubric):
- Green (proceed / ramp): 99p latency < 350ms, error rate < 0.5%, cost per 1k tokens within expected band (-10% to +25% of forecast), evaluation pass rate >= 95%.
- Amber (throttle / investigate): 99p latency 350-600ms OR error rate 0.5-2% OR cost per 1k tokens > 25% above forecast OR eval pass rate 85-95%. Requires immediate mitigation plan within 30m and update in #prodops-launch.
- Red (pause rollout / rollback): 99p latency > 600ms OR error rate > 2% OR cost per 1k tokens > 100% of forecast OR eval pass rate < 85% OR customer SLA breaches > 3 in 1 hour. Trigger: hold new traffic, execute rollback policy, notify execs and affected customers.

Prelaunch checklist (fast items to complete pre-traffic shift):
- [ ] Canary in region eu-west-1 serving 2% traffic (owner: Lina)
- [ ] Synthetic smoke tests + golden prompts executed every 5m (owner: Eng QA)
- [ ] Alerting thresholds pushed to ops alert manager (owner: SRE)
- [ ] Rollout flag gating implemented in Console with immediate kill switch (owner: Console)
- [ ] Billing forecast sanity check (owner: Finance ops)
- [ ] Support playbook updated with canned responses and escalation matrix (owner: Samir)
- [ ] Feature doc + rollback steps posted to #prodops-launch (owner: Maya)

Scenario playbooks (operational steps) - short & actionable:
1) Scenario: Latency spike (amber)
   - Detect: 99p latency > 350ms sustained for 5m.
   - Triage owner: SRE oncall.
   - Quick checks: infra CPU/GPU saturation, queue depth, kernel failures, batch size anomalies.
   - Immediate remedy: reduce max-batch size for affected model variant (serving-runtime param) and enable per-customer rate limits for heavy tenants.
   - Communication: post summary + current metric snapshot to #prodops-launch and ping SRE lead.

2) Scenario: Cost runaway (amber -> red)
   - Detect: cost per 1k tokens > 25% above forecast for 30m.
   - Owner: Finance ops + Product Ops.
   - Triage: confirm billing ingestion lag, verify if token mix changed (more long-context requests), check quantization pipeline anomalies.
   - Immediate remedy (amber): enable conservative quantized variant for non-critical customers, enable aggressive caching where applicable.
   - Immediate remedy (red): pause non-paid feature toggles, restrict burst capacity for Dedicated pools, partially rollback to previous model config.
   - Customer comms: notify impacted customers via support-runbook.

3) Scenario: Quality regression (red)
   - Detect: eval pass rate drops below 85% OR 3 customer complaints with reproducible prompt failures.
   - Owner: Applied ML + Product.
   - Actions: hold rollout, switch traffic to verified fallback model (tag: v1-stable), open an urgent RCA ticket, run prioritized regression set and share top-10 failure cases in #serving-runtime.
   - Timing: immediate hold and 2-hour deep-dive with results posted.

Monitoring plan & dashboards (who builds what):
- Eng SRE: latency/error/queue dashboards (source: metrics pipeline) - ETA: D-3
- Product Ops: KPI summary sheet (single-row daily snapshot) - link: sheets:traffic-probe-2025 - ETA: D-5
- Finance: cost burn dashboard (hourly) - ETA: D-2
- Applied ML: eval pass rate widget + sample failures - ETA: D-1
- Alerts: Pager duty rules for red triggers (SRE oncall) and Slack alarms for amber (channel-only).

Rollout plan (phased):
- Phase 0 (internal): smoke + ENG-only traffic (today -> +2d)
- Phase 1 (canary): 1% traffic for 24h (eu-west-1). Criteria: no amber level events for 6h, green pass on evals.
- Phase 2 (beta): 10% traffic for 48h (multi-region), finalize support playbook.
- Phase 3 (gradual ramp): 25% -> 50% -> 100% over 7 days, each step gated by green thresholds for 12h.

Comms & stakeholder cadence:
- Hourly updates in #prodops-launch during first 24h of canary.
- Twice-daily sync for execs (if amber persists > 6h): short readout (owner: Maya).
- Customer communications: templated messages in support-runbook, targeted emails for Dedicated customers if their SLA risk is elevated.

Unresolved questions / open items (sticky):
- How tolerant are Enterprise customers to temporary fallback model (affects SLA wording)? (action: legal + acct mgmt to confirm)
- Is billing ingestion delay likely to mask cost spikes for the first 2 hours? (action: Finance ops to verify ingestion latency)
- Should we pre-warm Dedicated pools for top-10 tenants? (action: Solutions Eng to propose list and cost)

Quick decision matrix (for product ops lead):
- If any red trigger -> pause new traffic AND call SRE + Applied ML (immediate).
- If two amber triggers in different KPI buckets within 30m -> escalate to red decision (exec notified).
- If amber resolved within 30m with a mitigant -> proceed but mark as incident and add to postmortem backlog.

Post-launch: measurement and postmortem plan:
- 72-hour postmortem draft by product ops (owner: Maya) capturing: what, why, mitigations, follow ups.
- 30-day adoption KRs: daily active customers using feature, error-free request rate, unit economics delta vs forecast.
- Suggested follow-ups: permanent alert tuning, expanded regression prompt set, customer-specific throttles.

Notes to self / quick todos:
- Create a minimal dashboard view for execs (top-line only) — ask data infra for widget.
- Confirm rollback playbook includes DB migration revert steps (if config changes require it).
- Run a dry-run of 'kill switch' in staging and document the exact commands.

References / links:
- CONFLUENCE-PLT-4521 (rollout runbook)
- JIRA-PRJ-1187 (canary infra work)
- sheets:traffic-probe-2025 (kpi summary sheet)
- https://github.com/redwood-inference/rfcs/pull/212 (model fallback RFC)
